picks.editorial_note: Penn's implantable Smart Neurostimulation System, the product of decades of computational memory modeling, represents a genuine breakthrough in predicting and treating memory loss — a rare case of AI research translating directly into a clinical device.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: A Fermilab-led team was selected under DOE's new Genesis Mission to build AI systems that optimize particle accelerator performance, marking a major national investment in AI for fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: A £5 million UK government-backed trial pairing Cambridge and Google-led AI models to reduce contrail-driven climate warming is a concrete, policy-relevant test of AI's role in mitigating aviation's climate impact.
picks.title: Operation Blue Skies takes off: landmark trial to test AI-driven contrail avoidance

picks.editorial_note: Purdue's Rosen Center is a partner on NSF Integrated Data Systems and Services grants totaling over $42 million, funding national-scale AI and data cyberinfrastructure that will underpin research well beyond Purdue.
picks.title: Purdue enables AI- and data- cyberinfras...
picks.university: Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing

picks.editorial_note: NCSA and UCLA's $9 million NSF-funded iDLab will unify browser-based access to national HPC centers, directly advancing the NAIRR pilot's goal of democratizing AI research infrastructure.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Johns Hopkins' partnership with Toyota Research Institute applies AI and automated high-throughput experimentation to battery materials discovery, an industry-academia pairing with direct clean-energy applications.
picks.title: Johns Hopkins team partners with Toyota Research Institute to accelerate new battery discovery

picks.editorial_note: A University of Houston report projecting up to 32% growth in U.S. electricity demand by 2030, driven substantially by AI and data centers, is a data point policymakers and grid planners will need to reckon with.
picks.title: University of Houston Report Predicts U.S. Electricity Demand Could Rise 32% by 2030 | University of Houston

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' — that outputs from large generative models often can't be traced to specific training examples — has real implications for AI copyright and provenance debates.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: MIT study finds generated images often can't be traced to any training data

picks.editorial_note: Stony Brook's new Department of Technology, AI and Society, backed by a $5 million SUNY grant, signals institutional investment in studying AI's societal effects, not just building the technology itself.
picks.title: Wohn Named Inaugural Chair of New Department of Technology, AI and Society - SBU News

picks.editorial_note: Imperial College London and Smith+Nephew's five-year centre will translate AI and computer-vision research into surgical robotics, a partnership positioned to move academic breakthroughs into clinical practice.
picks.title: New centre from Imperial and Smith+Nephew will accelerate innovation in surgical robotics
